title: Foundation ready checkpoint after SKR04, posting groups, VAT and dimensions boundaries
purpose: Classify W1 Foundation after SKR04 starter accounts, posting group prerequisites, parked General Posting Setup route, parked VAT matrix and revalidated Dimensions starter set.

smartDecision.whyNow: The visible W1 Foundation building blocks have either been proven, parked, or blocked. Before master data, the project needs a checkpoint that prevents overclaiming posting readiness.
smartDecision.risk: Moving to master data without a checkpoint could hide parked setup gaps.
smartDecision.fallback: If the checkpoint finds a hard blocker, create the next narrow setup case instead of unlocking master data.

entryCriteria: TARGET-033 result exists and is reviewed.
No setup write, master data, Preview Posting or Posting occurred in TARGET-033.
acceptanceCriteria: Foundation status is classified as ready, ready-with-parked-boundaries, or blocked.
Master Data remains locked unless the checkpoint explicitly unlocks it with boundaries.
No BC or Playwright execution is needed for the checkpoint.

nextStepDecision.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-033 revalidated starter dimensions and values; TARGET-032F parked Page 314; TARGET-027D24 parked VAT matrix; TARGET-030/031B proved customer/vendor posting groups.
nextStepDecision.reason: A local checkpoint prevents overclaiming and defines whether any master data work can begin.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: The previous W1 evidence is sufficient for a local classification without BC.
Read-only inspection of customer, vendor, item and location cards/templates can proceed without creating records.
Actual creation depends on TARGET-035 required-field/template evidence and the explicit acceptance of parked VAT/Page314 boundaries.
Preview requires master data plus accepted posting/VAT boundaries.
Posting requires Preview evidence and expected entry trace.

queueChangesMade: Marked TARGET-034 done as a no-BC foundation checkpoint.
Kept actual master data creation, Preview Posting and Posting locked.
nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It advances toward beginner-friendly master data chapters without writing records while Page 314 and VAT setup remain parked.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not click New if it would create a record.
Do not fill or save fields.
Do not claim posting readiness from card/template visibility.
requiredPreparation: Inspect only read-only card/list/template surfaces for customers, vendors, items and locations.
Capture required fields, visible posting group fields, template prompts and abort rules.

result: W1 Foundation classified as partial: not posting-ready, not preview-ready, actual master data creation locked; read-only master data cards/templates preflight selected.

proved: W1 Foundation is not Preview Posting-ready.

A read-only Master Data preflight is now useful because starter accounts, customer/vendor posting groups, starter posting groups and starter dimensions are known enough to inspect cards, templates and required fields.
TARGET-034 did not open BC, run Playwright, change setup, create master data, create drafts, preview or post.
notProved: No full SKR04 chart of accounts is proven.
No German VAT correctness is proven.
No General Posting Setup INLAND/WAREN/4400/5400 matrix row is proven.
No Inventory Posting Setup is proven.

warnings: Do not interpret this checkpoint as posting readiness.

Do not write German VAT claims before VAT setup, Preview Posting, VAT Entries and G/L Entries exist.
